Tesla Model 3 2023 Hatchback is a,

 performance-oriented petrol car with a 4.7L V6/V8 engine delivering 260 hp and 606 Nm of torque.

It features a CVT transmission

, reaches 0–60 mph in 6.6 seconds,

 and has a top speed of 253 km/h.
